title: Template Slate: compact responsive screenshot set + annotated README
creator: Asha Patel
description: Create a compact, consistently framed screenshot set and an annotated one-page README diagram for the new 'Template Slate' reference app variant. Deliverables will be used across: (1) the public documentation quickstart, (2) the Templates demo gallery, and (3) the GitHub starter repo README. Priorities: clarity at small sizes, real-ish placeholder data, and asset export tokens for engineering to consume in the docs CI pipeline.
acceptance_criteria: Eight final PNG exports covering desktop (1366px), tablet (768px), and mobile (375px) for the primary ‘Slate’ flow (onboarding -> generate -> settings), each exported with device-safe margins and 2x retina variants
One annotated single-page README diagram (SVG) showing the callout flow: API key -> quickstart run -> console view -> cost summary; diagram must be copy-edit ready and accessible (text selectable)
Figma source file with named slices and export tokens, organized into /exports/screenshots and /exports/readme, and published to the team library
Assets uploaded to Drive and linked in the GitHub PR; screenshots referenced from docs repo examples with relative paths
Design review sign-off captured in comments and at least one round of PM feedback addressed
